YOUR WEDDING-DAY STARTING POINT

Start with your ceremony.

A flexible same-day example. Check travel, preparation and supplier timing for your wedding.

MAKE IT YOURS

A starting point. Your own way forward.

Use the public tool to explore. Your private account holds your own wedding details.

01

Start with the moments that anchor your day

Confirm ceremony access, travel, photography light, meal service and supplier finishing times. Work backwards from the ceremony and forwards from dinner.

02

Build in breathing room

Allow time for getting dressed, moving between spaces, gathering people for photographs and simply enjoying being married. Check the schedule with the people delivering it.

03

Keep a shared version

Once your timing is settled, share the current run sheet with your venue and suppliers. Inside WedSparks, your wedding-day plan can hold your own moments, locations and notes.
